title: A darker, gloomier world
changes: The world is darker and gloomier: drained colours, deeper shadows, dark mossy grass and grey-brown mud instead of bright green.
New trees: tall ragged pines, gaunt half-bare spruces and dead trees; thorny brambles instead of berry bushes. No more stepped rings on the grass.
Blizzard is now a storm of snow and ice turning around the wizard.

Spell keys layout: Q is the first spell key (Q W E R T 1-5), the ranged weapon moved to V, Space walks like a left click when no spell is on it, and holding Tab makes you stand still and attack in place.
